trustModel: The real Career V2 modules exercised against the test account adapter, which enforces the same ownership rules the SQL policies enforce. Live database RLS is certified separately in live-rls-qa.json.

checks.name: deletion calls the admin endpoint for exactly the given user, with DELETE
a malformed user id is refused and no request is made
a rejected server credential is reported distinctly
a 404 is treated as already deleted
the server takes the user id from the verified token, never the body
deletion is gated by a typed phrase in the UI
deletion is gated by reauthentication in the UI

cascade: auth.users → profiles, saved_clashes, saved_rosters, user_preferences, result_claims
